Flag packages that create or execute batch/PowerShell scripts, especially if they download files from non-standard domains or IPs. Detect execution of PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass and rundll32 during install. Look for rapid creation and deletion of suspicious files (e.g., preinstall.bat, preinstall.ps1, sqlite.a, preinstall.db) and post-install modification of package.json to remove install hooks. Correlate with network activity to known malicious IPs/domains.
